Operating Expenses is stored negative to follow this file own sign convention for that row. | CRON 20261014: Japaul Gold and Ventures Plc unaudited condensed statement of comprehensive income for the period ended June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), Jan-Jun 2026 column, N'000 scaled to naira. Revenue less Cost of Sales equals the printed Gross Profit and Operating Profit less Net Finance Costs equals the printed Profit Before Tax; no income tax was charged in the period. | Japaul Gold and Ventures Plc audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, five year financial summary, group column. Cost of Sales computed as Revenue minus Gross Profit. Every period checked: Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit, and Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit, on the issuer printed column. | CRON 2026-11-08: Income Tax filled as 0 because the issuer's own Q2 2026 filing prints income tax expense as nil for the six months to 30 June 2026 and profit for the period equals profit before tax (795,181 thousand naira). Source: https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47737_JAPAUL_GOLD_AND_VENTURES_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf | CRON 20261128: EPS 9M 2026 left blank: the unaudited Q3 2026 statement (NGX doclib, Japaul Gold and Ventures Plc quarter 3 2026 financial statements, 9 pages) prints no earnings per share line; the delivered document ends before an EPS note. Not a collector failure. | CRON 2026-11-28: 9M 2026 EPS 0.105 is derived from the file own printed rows: profit of 1,500,116,000 naira divided by 14,262,700,000 shares, the count implied by the printed share capital of 7,131,350 thousand naira at 50 kobo par. The Q3 2026 filing prints no earnings per share line, so this cell is arithmetic on printed figures, not a filed figure.

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: this statement does not present operating profit as gross profit less one operating-expense line (the bridge runs through further income and expense headings the panel does not carry), so the two-row identity does not apply; every figure is as filed. Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit does not hold in FY2024: this statement does not present gross profit as revenue less one cost-of-sales line, so the two-row identity does not apply; the figures are as filed.
